content: Clone/duplicate conventions: pre-filled clone form/dialog where unique fields (serial, inventory number) are blanked or pre-generated; generate numbers on save (server-side) not on form load to avoid collisions; DB-level UNIQUE constraint is the real defense (OutSystems forum, koder.ai layered defenses); shadcn.io duplicate-record block shows editable preview dialog before create; frameworks (Backpack, Django admin) do NOT clone relations/timeline by default — explicit decision needed.
